description: Refreshes verification, DNS, and certificate state for a custom domain, stores that status, and returns it. Inputs: slug, domain, and token. status is pending_dns, verifying, issuing_cert, active, or error. dns_records are the records to create. An error includes the reason. A transition to active can notify a webhook registered for domain.active.

slug.description: Slug the hostname is attached to.

token.description: Bearer token returned by your first publish (deed_tok_...). Optional if the MCP client sends Authorization: Bearer.

name: domain_status
title: Refresh custom domain status
